name: trustanchor-engine1
description: TrustAnchor Engine 1 — deterministic cryptographic credential verification. Implements the frozen Engine 1 specification: Ed25519 signatures, SHA-256 hashing, canonical CBOR encoding, offline signing, and a runtime that holds no signing keys.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/offline-signer && npm run build --workspace=packages/backend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspace=packages/backend
